reconstruction.scope: Standing Omar Khayyam Mausoleum: ten paired curving/crossing pale stone ribbon legs around broad turquoise/ivory tiled lower diamonds and upper petals, true elongated open gaps and rounded ten-petal crown/small closed central rosette. Deep ribbon sides, metric shared tile/stone surfaces and original restrained geometric leaf/lozenge decoration imply the tile fields without reproducing inscriptions. Separate ten feet, occupied circular paving/short perimeter step, low central grave marker and simplified folded edge panels. No opaque generic tower/dome, traced calligraphy/photo atlas, furnished visitor facilities, trees/temporary equipment or whole garden.
